entries.en: Luckily for you, there is no city with a jail in this technical alpha version. You're starving and exhausted instead! Your reputation across the land has also taken a serious hit.
entries.ro: Din fericire pentru tine, în această versiune alfa tehnică nu există niciun oraș cu temniță. În schimb ești flămând și extenuat! Reputația ta în întreaga țară a suferit și ea o lovitură serioasă.

entries.en: If you want to know what's going on in the vicinity or find out if anyone needs your help, it's best to ask the local innkeeper, who's sure to know all the local gossip.
entries.ro: If you want to know what's going on in the vicinity or find out if anyone needs your help, it's best to ask the local innkeeper, who's sure to know all the local gossip.

entries.en: If you want to try your hand at gambling, it’s possible to play the dice game of Farkle in every respectable tavern.
entries.ro: Dacă vrei să încerci norocul la jocuri de noroc, în orice tavernă respectabilă poți juca zaruri, jocul Farkle.

entries.en: Alchemy is a useful skill that transforms herbs and other ingredients into potions and remedies. In order to brew those, you need a knowledge of alchemy, a recipe, an alchemist’s bench and the necessary ingredients.
entries.ro: Alchemy is a useful skill that transforms herbs and other ingredients into potions and remedies. In order to brew those, you need a knowledge of alchemy, a recipe, an alchemist’s bench and the necessary ingredients.

entries.en: Once you’ve become skilled enough at alchemy, you’ll have the option of auto-brewing potions.
entries.ro: Odată ce ai devenit destul de iscusit în alchimie, vei avea posibilitatea să prepari poțiuni automat.

entries.en: Bleeding is a specific type of injury. If you're bleeding, you must quickly bandage the wound, otherwise you'll soon bleed out and die.
entries.ro: Bleeding is a specific type of injury. If you're bleeding, you must quickly bandage the wound, otherwise you'll soon bleed out and die.

entries.en: Keep in mind that during combat it is not possible to heal yourself!
entries.ro: Keep in mind that during combat it is not possible to heal yourself!

entries.en: If you want to maintain bladed weapons, you can save your repair kit and hone them yourself on a grinding wheel, which you can find at every smithy.
entries.ro: If you want to maintain bladed weapons, you can save your repair kit and hone them yourself on a grinding wheel, which you can find at every smithy.

entries.en: Life is God’s gift and combat doesn’t always have to end in death! So when it’s clear that a combatant is beaten, he always has the option to surrender honourably, and the honourable response is to accept his surrender.
entries.ro: Life is God’s gift and combat doesn’t always have to end in death! So when it’s clear that a combatant is beaten, he always has the option to surrender honourably, and the honourable response is to accept his surrender.

entries.en: If a guard, catchpole or other figure of authority challenges you to surrender or to agree to a personal search, you can do so. But you’d better decide quick, because the guardians of the law have little patience in these troubled times and they won’t hesitate to use force if you don’t cooperate.
entries.ro: If a guard, catchpole or other figure of authority challenges you to surrender or to agree to a personal search, you can do so. But you’d better decide quick, because the guardians of the law have little patience in these troubled times and they won’t hesitate to use force if you don’t cooperate.

entries.en: In order to pickpocket someone successfully, you first have to sneak up on them unnoticed.
entries.ro: In order to pickpocket someone successfully, you first have to sneak up on them unnoticed.

entries.en: If you want to store things to use later, you can put them in the trunk you'll find at any of your assigned or rented sleeping places. The same items can be found in all the trunks you have.
entries.ro: If you want to store things to use later, you can put them in the trunk you'll find at any of your assigned or rented sleeping places. The same items can be found in all the trunks you have.

entries.en: The Codex accumulates all information about the world, points of interest and detailed tutorials.
entries.ro: The Codex accumulates all information about the world, points of interest and detailed tutorials.

entries.en: You can skip time and wait for something. If you’re in the middle of some activity, however, the Skip Time button will call up Help.
entries.ro: You can skip time and wait for something. If you’re in the middle of some activity, however, the Skip Time button will call up Help.

entries.en: If your loot is really hot, it’s best to go to a known fence. For example, the millers have a reputation for being mixed up in shady deals.
entries.ro: Dacă prada ta e prea fierbinte, cel mai bine e să mergi la un receptator cunoscut. De exemplu, morarii au reputația de a fi amestecați în afaceri dubioase.

entries.en: While brewing potions it’s always best to follow the recipe in the book. You can also easily set all the necessary ingredients straight onto the alchemy bench.
entries.ro: Când prepari poțiuni, e întotdeauna cel mai bine să urmezi rețeta din carte. Poți, de asemenea, să așezi ușor toate ingredientele necesare direct pe masa de alchimie.

entries.en: No one is born a master swordsman. It takes practice. Captain Bernard will show you the basics at the start, but to achieve mastery you'll have to visit him repeatedly.
entries.ro: Nimeni nu se naște maestru al sabiei. Trebuie exersare. Căpitan Bernard îți va arăta bazele la început, dar ca să ajungi la măiestrie va trebui să-l vizitezi din nou și din nou.

entries.en: If you find yourself heavily outnumbered, the best option may be "run away - live to fight another day". You can always come back when you're more skilled at combat, more stealthy or fortified with potions.
entries.ro: Dacă te găsești copleșit de numărul celor care te înconjoară, cea mai bună opțiune poate fi „fugi – ca să trăiești și să lupți altă dată”. Poți oricând să te întorci când ești mai iscusit în luptă, mai furiș sau întărit cu poțiuni.

entries.en: If you end up on the wrong side of the law, it's best to save your reputation by submitting to arrest and cleansing your soul with a little jail time.
entries.ro: Dacă ajungi de partea greșită a legii, cel mai bine e să-ți salvezi reputația, supunându-te arestării și curățindu-ți sufletul cu puțin timp petrecut la închisoare.

entries.en: Even if you're not caught red-handed, your crimes will make people bad-tempered, and angry guards are more likely to stop and search you, angry traders to be less willing to haggle.
entries.ro: Chiar dacă nu ești prins asupra faptului, crimele tale îi vor face pe oameni nervoși, iar gărzile furioase vor fi mai predispuse să te oprească și să te percheziționeze, iar negustorii furioși vor fi mai puțin dispuși să târguiască.

entries.en: There are big differences between horses. A new one costs a lot, but it's a worthwhile investment - not just to get around faster, but also to carry a heavier load.
entries.ro: Există mari deosebiri între cai. Unul nou costă mult, dar e o investiție care merită – nu doar ca să ajungi mai repede, ci și ca să cari o povară mai grea.

entries.en: Even your finest clothing can lose it's charm if hidden beneath battered armour or a layer of dirt and blood.
entries.ro: Chiar și cele mai frumoase haine își pot pierde farmecul dacă sunt ascunse sub o armură zdrobită sau sub un strat de murdărie și sânge.

entries.en: Theresa acquires and improves skills just like Henry, but some will not be available to her in Skalitz, such as horse-riding, alchemy and pickpocketing. These skills have a zero value in the character's stats.
entries.ro: Theresa dobândește și își perfecționează îndemânările la fel ca Henry, dar unele nu vor fi disponibile pentru ea la Skalitz, cum ar fi călăria, alchimia și buzunăritul. Aceste îndemânări au valoarea zero în atributele personajului.

entries.en: Every unsuccessful bout of haggling lowers your reputation with the trader. On the contrary, if you tip the trader or give him or her a discount, your reputation will improve.
entries.ro: Every unsuccessful bout of haggling lowers your reputation with the trader. On the contrary, if you tip the trader or give him or her a discount, your reputation will improve.

entries.en: Theresa does not acquire perk points, but you can unlock new perks for her by completing certain objectives.
entries.ro: Theresa nu câștigă puncte de talent, dar poți debloca talente noi pentru ea îndeplinind anumite obiective.

entries.en: There's no cross-dressing in the middle ages! Just as Henry cannot put on women's clothes, neither can Theresa wear men's.
entries.ro: Nu există travestiuri în Evul Mediu! La fel cum Henry nu poate purta haine de femeie, nici Theresa nu poate purta haine de bărbat.

entries.en: Theresa is accompanied everywhere by her faithful dog, Tinker, who can help her in combat, tracking people and sniffing out interesting things.
entries.ro: Theresa e însoțită peste tot de câinele ei credincios, Tinker, care o poate ajuta în luptă, la urmărirea oamenilor și la descoperirea lucrurilor interesante.

entries.en: Skalitz is a small but important settlement with a castle, which gets its prestige from the local silver mines. All the silver belongs to the king.
entries.ro: Skalitz e o așezare mică, dar importantă, cu un castel, care își datorează prestigiul minelor de argint din apropiere. Tot argintul aparține regelui.

entries.en: Theresa is capable of wielding a weapon, but that doesn't make her a warrior. It's usually best to find another way to resolve conflicts.
entries.ro: Theresa știe să mânuiască o armă, dar asta nu o face războinică. De obicei, cel mai bine e să găsești o altă cale de a rezolva conflictele.

entries.en: Work at the mines is tough, but not only men do it. In the sorting plant where the ore is separated, it is mostly women who do the work.
entries.ro: Munca la mine e grea, dar nu o fac doar bărbații. În atelierul de sortare unde se separă minereul, munca o fac în mare parte femeile.

entries.en: If you need a light at night, use your torch.
entries.ro: If you need a light at night, use your torch.

entries.en: You also need to watch what you eat – if you eat or drink something that’s spoiled, you can get food poisoning, which you can only cure by taking Digestive potion. You can tell you’ve been poisoned by the icon next to your health indicator.
entries.ro: You also need to watch what you eat – if you eat or drink something that’s spoiled, you can get food poisoning, which you can only cure by taking Digestive potion. You can tell you’ve been poisoned by the icon next to your health indicator.

entries.en: Reading was a rare skill in the middle ages and a common blacksmith's son certainly wouldn't have been literate. If you want to learn to read, you need to find someone who'll teach you.
entries.ro: Reading was a rare skill in the middle ages and a common blacksmith's son certainly wouldn't have been literate. If you want to learn to read, you need to find someone who'll teach you.

entries.en: When you’re dirty, you don’t have to rush immediately to the nearest bathhouse – you can have a quick wash at the nearest water trough.
entries.ro: When you’re dirty, you don’t have to rush immediately to the nearest bathhouse – you can have a quick wash at the nearest water trough.

entries.en: In these harsh times, people are wary of anything out of the ordinary. If you step inside someone's house uninvited, for example, they will first warn you that you've no business there, but if you do anything untoward there, they will immediately call for a guard.
entries.ro: În vremurile acestea grele, oamenii se feresc de orice lucru neobișnuit. Dacă intri în casa cuiva fără invitație, de pildă, te vor avertiza mai întâi că nu ai ce căuta acolo, dar dacă faci ceva necuviincios, vor chema imediat un gardian.

entries.en: Alcohol is a useful thing, but it's also the scourge of mankind and a good Christian should avoid it like the plague.
entries.ro: Alcoolul e un lucru folositor, dar e și flagelul omenirii, iar un bun creștin trebuie să-l ocolească precum ciuma.

entries.en: It seems you have uninstalled a mod that added new content (items, NPCs, perks etc.) and this content has been deleted in the process.
entries.ro: Se pare că ai dezinstalat un mod care adăuga conținut nou (obiecte, personaje non-jucător, talente etc.), iar acest conținut a fost șters în proces.
